location.description: Kindle location URI: kindle:// to auto-detect the attached device, or kindle:///path/to/mountpoint to name it explicitly

documents.description: Back up the books stored on the device

annotations.description: Back up highlights, bookmarks, reading positions (the .sdr sidecar directories) and My Clippings.txt

system.description: Back up the device's system directory (collections, settings). Device-specific, and excludes regenerable caches such as thumbnails and search indexes

everything.description: Back up the whole volume verbatim, caches included, ignoring the selection above
